en.name: Pecans, shelled
en.summary: Shelled pecans keep only 2–4 weeks from purchase in the cupboard, but 9 months in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below and 24 months in the freezer at −18 °C (0 °F). Pecans carry a particularly fragile fat, so cold storage is not fussiness here — it is the difference between weeks and years.
en.pantry: 2–4 weeks from purchase in an airtight, opaque container, cool and away from the hob. That is a short window, and it catches people out, because a bag of pecans looks like a dry good that will sit quietly for a year. It will not: pecan oil is highly unsaturated, the shell is gone, and oxygen is doing its work from the moment the bag is packed. Light matters as much as heat, so a glass jar on a bright counter is the worst option in the kitchen.
en.fridge: 9 months from purchase at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, sealed hard. This is where shelled pecans should live if they are not going into the freezer. Cold slows the oxidation that makes them bitter, and it also keeps pantry moths out of the jar. Use a properly airtight container: pecans are mild and oily and will pick up the smell of anything strong sitting near them.
en.freezer: 24 months from purchase at −18 °C (0 °F). The nut holds almost no water, so freezing leaves the texture untouched and you can chop or toast them straight from frozen. Press the air out of the bag or use a rigid tub, and split a large purchase into portions so the whole lot is not opened every time you bake.
en.thawing: No thawing needed. Let the sealed bag reach room temperature before opening so condensation does not land on the nuts and soften them.
spoilage: A bitter, sharp taste — rancid pecan oil, unmistakable once you have met it.
A smell of old cooking oil, crayons or paint instead of sweet butteriness.
Nuts that are limp and chewy rather than crisp.
Mould, webbing or grubs in a jar that got damp or was left open.
tips: Treat shelled pecans as a fridge item unless you will finish them within a month.
Store in an opaque container; light drives rancidity as surely as warmth.
Toast them just before use — toasting a stale nut does not rescue it.
Buy from a shop with turnover; a bag may already be weeks into its life.

faq.q: How long do shelled pecans keep?
faq.a: 2–4 weeks from purchase in the cupboard, 9 months in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, or 24 months in the freezer at −18 °C (0 °F).

faq.q: Should pecans be kept in the fridge?
faq.a: Yes, unless you will eat them within a few weeks. Their fat is unusually fragile, and the fridge takes them from weeks to the better part of a year.

faq.q: How can you tell if pecans have gone bad?
faq.a: Eat one. Rancid pecans are bitter and taste of old oil. A musty smell or visible mould means the jar goes.

zh.name: 胡桃仁（去殼）
zh.summary: 去殼胡桃自購買日起放櫥櫃只有 2～4 週，但 4 °C 以下冷藏可放 9 個月，−18 °C 冷凍可放 24 個月。胡桃的油脂特別脆弱，所以「要冰起來」在這裡不是講究，而是幾週與幾年的差別。
zh.pantry: 不透光的氣密容器、陰涼、遠離爐台，自購買日起 2～4 週。這個窗口短得會讓人措手不及，因為一包胡桃看起來就像可以安靜放一年的乾貨。它不會：胡桃油高度不飽和，殼已經沒了，從封袋那一刻起氧氣就在動工。光線和溫度一樣要緊，所以玻璃罐擺在明亮檯面上是全廚房最糟的選項。
zh.fridge: 確實密封放 4 °C 以下，自購買日起 9 個月。不打算冷凍的話，去殼胡桃就該住在這裡。低溫拖慢讓它發苦的氧化，順便也把穀蛾擋在罐外。請用真正氣密的容器：胡桃味淡油多，旁邊任何味道重的東西它都會吸過來。
zh.freezer: −18 °C 下，自購買日起 24 個月。果仁幾乎不含水，冷凍不影響質地，要切碎或烘香都可以直接從冷凍拿出來做。請把袋中空氣壓出或改用硬盒，並把大包分成小份，免得每次烘焙都要開整包。
zh.thawing: 不需要解凍。請讓密封袋回到室溫再打開，免得水氣凝在果仁上讓它變軟。
spoilage: 嚐起來苦而尖銳——那是胡桃油油耗，聞過一次就忘不了。
聞起來像久放的油、蠟筆或油漆，而不是奶香甜香。
受潮或忘了蓋的罐子裡出現霉、絲網或蟲。
tips: 除非一個月內吃完，否則把去殼胡桃當成冷藏品。
用不透光容器；光線和溫度一樣會催出油耗。
要用之前才烘香；已經走味的果仁烘了也救不回來。
跟流通快的店家買；一包胡桃可能已經走了好幾週。

faq.a: 自購買日起，放櫥櫃 2～4 週，4 °C 以下冷藏 9 個月，−18 °C 冷凍 24 個月。
除非幾週內吃完，否則要。它的油脂格外脆弱，冷藏能把「幾週」變成大半年。
吃一顆。油耗的胡桃又苦又有久放的油味。有霉味或看得到霉，整罐就該丟。
